What changed, and why

Editorial lead

Was

Featured was one more small icon card in a three-column grid.

Now

The first featured guide is a large title with a Featured · type kicker and an Open guide action.

Type-grouped index

Was

Every guide used the same muted book-icon card, so How-to and Media Drive looked identical.

Now

Guides group under How-to, Media Drive, and General with Gotham titles and hairline rows or two-column tiles.

Quieter chrome

Was

Header packed tabs, New guide, and the SMB path. Two search fields sat side by side.

Now

Header is title, section switcher, and New guide. One search field plus compact ⌘K. Jump chips for How-to, Media Drive, Contacts, and Assignments. Path and directories live in a tools strip.
